title: U-Bench: A Comprehensive Understanding of U-Net through 100-Variant Benchmarking
mechanism: Statistically rigorous benchmark of 100 U-Net variants over 28 datasets and 10 modalities, with robustness tests, zero-shot generalisation and an accuracy-efficiency U-Score.
adaptation: Template for the EL benchmark: paired significance tests across seeds and folds, a zero-shot column (E1 and F51), an efficiency column; pick 5-8 suite members from its families via its 2D trainers.
min_experiment: Benchmark design, not a score arm: run U-Bench's statistical test on existing house v PF seed results; adopt if it reproduces the BRIEF minimum detectable difference (~0.012 crack IoU).
evidence: R: 100 variants, 28 datasets; third-party summary reports over 80% of variants not significantly better than U-Net in-domain (unverified).
